Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and the `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B) The orchestrator poller (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify/plan/implement phase workflows
D) Documentation only (README, `agents.md` fragments, `docs/`)
E) Something else. Name the file, workflow or feature in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for this change?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Link the failing run, issue or PR (RECOMMENDED)
B) Reduce cost or runtime (GitHub API calls, model tokens, CI minutes)
C) Add a new capability. Describe the behaviour you expect
D) Make the current behaviour clearer (logs, alerts, docs) without changing it
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A specific failing check, test or workflow run passes. Name it (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable metric improves. Give the metric and the target
C) A described behaviour is visible in a workflow run or PR comment. Describe it
